info.description: Platform integration requirements, not Discovery Engine endpoints or a new service mandate. Proposed normalized HTTP binding only; owners may adapt existing reviewed routes. Real owners retain identities, ledgers, allocation, charges and provisioning. Schema examples use placeholders only.

OwnerSession.description: Opaque approved session/delegation token; issuer, exchange, audience and scope mapping must reuse reviewed owner identity. This spec does not create a token issuer. Existing public catalog reads remain unchanged.

x-idempotency-policy: Keys bind owner, actor, stage/operation and immutable payload. Distinct stage keys for quote/hold/commit. Owner declares retention/status recovery; unknown outcomes never use blind fresh-key resubmission.
